description: `cli job disable JOB_ID` gets the `cli job stop` explanation: deleting a job stops its future runs; there is no pause.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown command.
Detail: unknown command `cli job disable`; did you mean `cli job delete JOB_ID`? deleting a job stops its future runs; there is no pause; a run in progress is cancelled with `cli run cancel RUN_ID --yes`
Action: Use `cli job delete`: `prose cli job delete 3c1a9e57-0b4d-4f2a-9e61-5d7b2c8a4f10`.
